name: jlcpcb-4layer-1oz

quotes.minimum_annular_ring_mm: Multilayer: 1 oz: Recommended 0.20 mm or above; absolute minimum 0.15 mm
quotes.minimum_via_annular_ring_mm: ① Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.
quotes.minimum_copper_to_edge_mm: ① Copper clearance from routed board edges: ≧0.2 mm
quotes.minimum_pth_hole_to_copper_mm: PTH to Track 0.28mm 0.35mm is recommended, minimum 0.28mm
quotes.minimum_silk_line_width_mm: Minimum Line Width ≥0.15mm Characters width less than 0.15mm will be unidentifiable.
quotes.minimum_smd_pad_to_pad_mm: SMD pad to pad clearance (different nets) 0.15mm
quotes.minimum_inner_pth_hole_to_copper_mm: Inner layer PTH pad hole to copper clearance 0.3mm
quotes.minimum_pad_to_silk_mm: The Minimum Distance Between Pad and Silkscreen is 0.15mm.
quotes.minimum_solder_mask_web_mm: 1oz: Min. pad spacing: 0.10 mm (green, red, yellow, blue, purple)

derivations.minimum_via_annular_ring_mm: Via ring = (diameter - hole) / 2 = 0.1 mm / 2 = 0.05 mm (the stated minimum, not the 0.15 mm preferred margin).
derivations.minimum_silk_text_height_mm: 40 mil = 1.016 mm; JLC states 1.0 mm for this row, which is used.

notes: 4-layer FR4, 1 oz finished outer copper. Same schema and keys as zapote/fab-profiles (zapote-check can read it); values re-read from the page on 2026-10-29, every quote a verbatim substring of source_text.
Ring limits are the vendor absolute minimum; the recommended figure stays in the quote, not enforced.
Hole spacing: via/via pairs use Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing; every other pair uses Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing (JLC states no via-to-pad rule; the stricter is kept).
Solder-mask web is for green, red, yellow, blue and purple mask on 1 oz; black and white need 0.13 mm.
